notes.title: HELLDIVERS 2: The Story So Far
notes.notes:
The Helldivers universe is one of noble soldiers, heroic deeds, and heartfelt, unflinching patriotism in the face of giant acid-spewing bug monsters. In the words of Game Writer Stephen Flowers:

[quote]I personally love writing for a game with opportunities for comedy, and that doesn't take itself too seriously. I hope I can find a game like that soon...[/quote]
If you want to catch up with the story of Super Earth and her valiant defenders, read on.

[previewyoutube=WsYK0Y6mjFE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Since [i]Helldivers…[/i][/h2]

HELLDIVERS 2 takes place a century after the events of the first game, with Super Earth having emerged victorious against its adversaries – the deadly, bug-like Terminids, the grotesque Cyborgs and the inscrutable Illuminates. With its foes vanquished and the Galactic War won, an era of peace and prosperity ensued. The Helldivers, Super Earth’s elite task force, were dismissed.

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExM2VtaXZ6dXN2cGdicmVnODFmejg3cjQ2eHYyNjYxbXZweWw0eWplbyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/q9Yoko9ZwOAVJRcE6X/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Super Earth entered its most peaceful and prosperous years.[/i]

The same faster-than-light travel technology, heroically liberated from the Illuminates, that gave Super Earth access to the galaxy, has since been used to colonize it. This period has come to be known as The Great Democratization. FTL technology is reliant on a steady supply of the precious substance E-710 which, luckily, can be found in decomposing Terminid bodies. So naturally, Super Earth has been farming Terminids on an industrial scale. 

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExenhjeHR3ZWwzYm0xMWY3NnVkY3l5MXh4ZHZmOHQ4MHh6dDU0dGZxbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/XgljKpw0N65BMadBB6/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]The success of Super Earth depends on the hard work of citizens.[/i]

[h2]Why Super Earth needs you[/h2]

In a shocking turn of events, the Terminids have broken free of their farms and begun spreading throughout the galaxy. The Super Earth Armed Forces have been struggling to quarantine them on their farm planets, but are stretched thin – so when a mysterious new enemy enters the fray, Super Earth has no choice but to mobilize the Helldivers once again. 

The Automatons are fully mechanized soldiers of a kind never seen before. But their emblem is eerily familiar …

It is now up to you, Helldiver, to don your cape and take back Super Earth’s colonies once and for all. You will be fighting these vile, freedom-hating foes on two fronts, as Super Earth works to implement a solution to the Terminid scourge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/e323e11335f97f8febeba1a6965286131db089b0.png[/img]
[i]Super Earth calls upon the Helldivers once again.[/i]

[h2]Doing your part[/h2]

As the Helldivers battle the foes of Super Earth, you will not only change the face of the galaxy, but the course of its history. Super Earth will issue global, time-sensitive Major Orders, challenging all players to work together to achieve large-scale goals, the outcome of which will shape the story going forward. Meaning, the story is not something that happens to players, but something the players themselves have to actively make happen.

As Stephen puts it:

[quote]What's unique about the story of Helldivers 2 is that it's driven by the player community. Planning for that is a huge challenge – we have what we think will happen, but we ultimately can't control what the players do. Which as a player I find cool, but as a writer I find really scary.

As for the story ahead, all I can say is that the galaxy will look very different a few months from now than it does today.
[/quote]
Can the Helldivers pull together to defend vital strategic outposts against overwhelming numbers, or complete grand story missions before another faction makes their move? Not only time, but the blood, sweat and mangled bodies of Helldivers will tell.

[h2]The Continuing War[/h2]

Super Earth’s struggle for supremacy doesn’t end there—your future as a Helldiver is secure! There’s so much more to come as we expand the game’s content offering. We’re excited to confirm that as players fight in the Galactic War, they will also witness events unfold through our planned free updates. The universe of HELLDIVERS 2 will grow and change to give our players refreshed gameplay, introducing new tools, new challenges, and new threats from around the galaxy.

Helldivers™2 releases on Steam this Thursday, February 8th. Pre-load is available today!

notes.title: WARBONDS: Supporting the Galactic War Effort
notes.notes:
What would a Helldiver be without their equipment? Our Deputy Game Director, Sagar Beroshi, sat down to talk to us about the Warbond system in HELLDIVERS 2!

[h3]What is a Warbond?[/h3]
“We're trying to model a unique type of live service with the Warbonds. They're like getting a treasure chest full of toys,” Sagar says. And he’s right: the Warbonds are your ticket to fighting the Galactic War in style with lots of unlockable gear, but they reflect the changing tides of war on Super Earth as well. “It's been a century since the last game, and Super Earth is starting to get its military-industrial complex churning again. And to whom would it be better to offer gear than the Helldivers?”

The items available will each have unique features that can offer a variety of tactics for play. “You're going to see some really cool items in the game, each one giving you different ways to approach problems within missions. So, get ready to armor up, drop in, and erase some enemy scum.”

[previewyoutube=U2WCGJYTX_4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]How do they work?[/h3]
Warbonds give you access to multiple pages of unlockable content that can be obtained in a couple of different ways. Apart from the first Warbond—[b]Helldivers Mobilize[/b]—which has been graciously gifted to you by Super Earth, you can unlock new Premium Warbonds using Super Credits. Super Credits can either be purchased from the in-game store or discovered in missions by exploring points of interest.

Once you own a Warbond, you spend your hard earned medals to unlock your desired toys. Medals are awarded by completing objectives, missions, and operations. Medals can also be found the old-fashioned way by exploring the battlefield.

Do you hate FOMO? We do! Sagar wants to be clear about the monetization in HELLDIVERS 2: “At Arrowhead, we're gamers too, and we want these Warbonds to feel modern, fun, and in line with the Arrowhead style. This is important to us: the Warbonds are NOT a pay-to-win, FOMO-driven system. Instead, the gear in the Warbonds just keeps accumulating. We will not retire earlier Warbonds as new ones are released - you can pick them up and complete them at any time!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/42dc2020478e59b6df41d208f14fdbcf6b757f33.jpg[/img]
[i]The JAR-5 Dominator, with its jet-propelled high-damage projectiles, is part of the Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond.[/i]

[b]Buying Warbonds - At a Glance[/b]
To get access to the Warbond and unlock items, follow these simple steps!
[list]
[*] Buy Super Credits (your virtual in-game currency) from the in-game “ACQUISITIONS” store, or discover whilst on in-game missions.
[*] Head in-game and browse the Warbond catalogues – check out all that gear you could unlock!
[*] Buy your Warbond of choice with your purchased Super Credits. 
[*] Complete missions to earn Medals (your in-game reward currency). 
[*] Spend those Medals to unlock more content from the Warbond catalogue.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/190d251b1f515b97c407ff3bb2b91a0b1695b00b.jpg[/img]
[i]The SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary, a modified shotgun with incendiary projectiles, part of the Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond.[/i]

[h3]The Superstore[/h3]
In addition to purchasing Warbonds, Super Credits can be used in the Superstore. The Superstore has a rotating storefront containing unique sets of armor, so that you can spread liberty in style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/69476e7b33dcdb63a1479cba38f2b8d0e8098353.jpg[/img]
[i]The Superstore features regularly refreshed content.[/i]

We’re excited for players to see the content we have planned for these and future Warbonds! HELLDIVERS 2 is launching, with the free [b]Helldivers Mobilize[/b] Warbond and the purchasable Steeled Veterans Premium Warbond, on February 8, 2024. Make sure to check it out! 

The Premium Warbond Steeled Veterans is included in our [b]Helldivers 2 Super Citizen Edition[/b]. Pre-order are available now!

notes.title: Helldivers 2: Join the Galactic War
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=22rg3bHqSVc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Galactic War[/h2]

One of the key features of Helldivers 2 is The Galactic War. Super Earth's territories are under siege on all fronts by monstrous enemies hell-bent on destroying humanity's way of life. From the war table aboard your ship, your team can watch as the conflict unfolds and take part in battles across the universe. You will do your part to advance the frontlines in the name of Freedom and Managed Democracy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/01d0b94f16bfc2212f17bd55f3ac3ed3b78b1484.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Helldivers[/h2]

Helldivers are the true heroes of Super Earth. As an elite soldier, you have the full might of Super Earth's arsenal at your disposal. Use your lethal array of stratagems and weaponry to defend its colonizers and liberate planets from enemy forces.

Rise through the ranks and take on increasingly difficult missions to solidify your place in Helldiver history – and if one Helldiver should perish, that's just an opportunity for another Citizen to realize their dream. Prosperity and liberty are your core values and it's your privilege to spread them. 

[h2]The Enemy Factions[/h2]

The robotic Automatons and the bug-like Termininds terrorize Super Earth citizens in the biggest conflict since the last Helldiver mobilization, over one hundred years ago. Each faction operates differently, and requires their own strategies – and stratagems – to face.

The work of a Helldiver never ends as more planets fall into the enemy’s clutches and the battle rages on. Play your part in an evolving war to reclaim planets for Super Earth and spread democracy and liberty to the furthest reaches of the galaxy. Conquer not only Super Earth’s foes but the elements themselves, as you brave a plethora of environmental hazards on the surface of alien worlds.

[h2]Missions and Operations[/h2]

Unite with your comrades in arms and monitor the conflict at the War Table together. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/31a111283bb7e17ba3c5eb7918ce68b78d85549c.jpg[/img]
[i]Assemble around the Galactic War map with your squad and choose your mission.[/i]

Once you choose a planet, the War Table will allow you to choose an operation to partake in. Operations consist of up to three missions, with a variety of primary objectives, like eradicating bug infestations, destroying enemy supplies, and retrieving valuable data.

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeWE3cmx1M2s2YXR2YWF4OXVlZnBiZmd4YmFjd3cwZDlnMGZ1ZjNpZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/YGdZumXl69ycFOxeyO/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]You can strategize with your team and build your load-outs collaboratively to prepare for the challenge ahead. [/i]

Embark on a range of different missions, from taking down high value targets or launching missiles to strike the heart of enemy strongholds. While fighting on the frontlines, keep your eyes open for potential resources and intel to bring back to Super Earth researchers. Your progress contributes to the overall war effort, and brings you closer to liberating that sector of the galaxy.

Super Earth is depending on you. Enlist today—Hellpods drop on February 8!

notes.title: HELLDIVERS™2 Has Gone Gold!
notes.notes:
Helldivers, report to the pod bays and prepare for your first dive—HELLDIVERS 2 has gone gold! 

[previewyoutube=oD3pxbG9YYI;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re back to talk about the eagerly awaited launch of HELLDIVERS 2 on PS5 and PC! Team up with your friends using crossplay and spread some Freedom and Managed Democracy. Prepare for some edge-of-your-seat, action-packed mayhem as you take down some of the galaxy's most formidable foes.

As the Galactic War rages on, you will face down the relentless Terminid scourge and the heartless Automaton regime with the help of the most powerful weapons in Super Earth’s arsenal. Build your loadouts, choose your mission, and dive into the fray.  Work as a team with up to three friends and spread Managed Democracy by any means necessary. But remember, in HELLDIVERS 2, friendly fire is always on! This means you’ll not only be dodging bugs and bots, but stray bullets from your fellow Helldivers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/07d8dbe752ae3570af9854896b47cf8ce39aded2.jpg[/img]

Make sure you sign up today to join the first wave! We are gearing up our Super Citizens who enlist early with the best gear Super Earth Credits can buy. Everyone knows defending Liberty is that much sweeter when you look good doing it. You will also gain access to the arcade game Stratagem Hero to play on your ship.

Galactic Liberation begins February 8. Pre-order now and receive 3 bonus armours, or upgrade to the Super Citizen edition for more extra goodies! Recruit your friends and enlist today!

notes.title: HELLDIVERS™ 2 PC SPECIFICATIONS AND CROSSPLAY SUPPORT CONFIRMED!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=x4b55Qdq3Rs;full][/previewyoutube]

We know it’s been a long wait but it’s finally time to reveal more about the PC release of HELLDIVERS™ 2. We know what’s on your mind, first and foremost: Is it crossplay? 

And we’re pleased to announce that HELLDIVERS™ 2 supports crossplay! That means your teammates on PC can play with you on PS5 and vice versa. Community and teamwork are the most important pillars of HELLDIVERS™ 2, and so it is essential to ensure players can work together regardless of the system they choose to use. Together we can celebrate victories, mourn losses, and liberate the galaxy without platform boundaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/e5de7852f91d6d3c57dfe2ecf33200e168a24dd5.jpg[/img]

As part of this announcement, we’re also finally able to provide you with the minimum, recommended, performance, and ultra system specifications for PC players to ensure that no matter what kind of equipment your squad uses to play – PS5 or PC with a broad range of supported PC hardware – you’ll be able to spread Managed Democracy together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/35db8b463f2143ba886189ce0a3c96720689f10c.jpg[/img]

Wondering if your PC can handle HELLDIVERS™ 2? Here are our PC system specifications:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40425349/661bc32ee61e2bb19e18e6ce31e0ca46914b4869.jpg[/img]

Now you’re armed with crossplay and the required specs to go on your very first dive. It’s not much longer to wait, recruits: HELLDIVERS™ 2 is launching on February 8, and pre-orders are open now. We can’t wait to see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Wishing you all a happy Liberty Day!
notes.notes:
Citizens and Helldivers, it’s Liberty Day! Every year on October 26th, we celebrate the anniversary of Managed Democracy on Super Earth, where they fought from the darkness into the light of Freedom.

Our veteran Helldivers are familiar with our most important holiday, but as we prepare to launch HELLDIVERS™ 2 next year, we’re also welcoming a whole new generation of players to celebrate with us.

So what is Liberty Day? We had a chat with founder Malin Hedström, Lucy Armelin from community & support, and narrative lead Nils Hansson Bjerke about the inspiration behind the holiday, both in-game and out.

[previewyoutube=Q6STNDADImI;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=tOWwJXwxqIA;full][/previewyoutube]

And finally… We require that all new recruits take a moment to reflect on what Super Earth has done for democracy. By Super Earth law, you are required to view this year’s Liberty Day PSA, but from us at Arrowhead we hope you also enjoy it.

[previewyoutube=CISKVP3edjs;full][/previewyoutube]

Wishing you all a happy Liberty Day! 
HELLDIVERS™ 2 is almost here, recruits! We’ll see you on the battlefield on February 8th!

—
Want to talk about all things HELLDIVERS? Join our Discord!
https://discord.com/invite/YA5NHvjDp3

notes.title: Helldivers is four years old and still being updated
notes.notes:
Every year around Liberty Day, which is October 26 in the futuristic Super Earth of Helldivers' setting, Arrowhead Studios release an update for their game of twin-stick co-op chaos. This year it comes with a new subtitle, and will be called Helldivers: Dive Harder from now on.

The main change in Dive Harder is a mode called Proving Grounds, a replayable urban mission where big alien bugs have been let loose in a training facility. Three different Proving Grounds will be available during the campaign, unlocking as you go, then resetting at the end. If you make it to the top of the leaderboards during that time, you get a cape. And bragging rights, I guess.

The loadout system is also changing, gaining an option to preselect favorite loadouts or randomize them. A bunch of tweaks and balance changes are on the way as well and will be detailed in the next set of patch notes. One change Arrowhead note in their blog: "yes, you can now skip the Galactic Campaign Summary..."

Arrowhead will be running a stream on their Twitch channel to cover the new update on October 25 at 9am PDT.

notes.title: Helldivers:A New Hell Liberty Day Update
notes.notes:
Dust off those celebratory capes, Divers! To commemorate Liberty Day 2018, Super Earth Command is giving you what you want: more Freedom. More Democracy. MORE LIBERTY.

[b]Are you ready to dive into A New Hell?[/b]

[h1][b]New Difficulties[/b][/h1]
Just when you thought you had mastered the art of Helldiving, we’ve gone and added more planet difficulties. Now you have An Exercise in Futility (lvl13), where you learn The Definition of Insanity (lvl14), preparing you for the Inner Circle of Hell (lvl15). Veterans, dust off those capes, you’ve got work to do!

[h1][b]Tougher Enemies[/b][/h1]
The alien scumbags have been preparing to strike for months now. Gathering Super Earth intelligence, they’ve adjusted their tactics to become a more formidable enemy. It’ll take the full power of Super Earth’s arsenal to stop them.

[*][b]Shadow:[/b] Believed to be an evolution of the STALKER, these HUNTERS have greater regenerative capabilities but the same weak armor as their predecessor. It also retains the same camouflage ability, but has evolved a way of releasing the spores capable of luring other BUGs to its position.

[*][b]Obsidian Observer: [/b]The OBSIDIAN OBSERVER is believed to be a weaponized version of the WATCHER. With nanotechnology weaponized and added to their scout units they have crossed a delicate line and showing that they have no problems using their detestable weaponry on a larger scale.

[*][b]Legionnaire: [/b]The LEGIONNAIRE is an up-armored 'SQUADLEADER' SOLDIER taking a page from the HULK book and protecting itself with a heavy shield. While nothing that can't be handled by anti tank weapons, the LEGIONNAIRE is an increased threat to LIBERTY and DEMOCRACY.[/list]

[b][h1]New Stratagem[/h1][/b]
Super Earth Command has issued new equipment for all Helldivers, once they have the appropriate clearance.

[*][b]MGX-42 Machinegun: [/b]The MGX-42 is a magazineless, one-use, disposable machinegun designed to be discarded after having fired its ammunition. The 300 rounds of caseless ammunition are stacked in the multiple barrels and fired electronically making the weapon almost void of mechanical parts and cheap to manufacture.[/list]

[h1][b]Liberty Day Competitions[/b][/h1]
Do you want to get your hands on some Helldivers goodies or have the chance at winning a real life Helldivers cape? Read the Liberty Day blog post (http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2018/10/helldivers-its-that-time-again-liberty-day-2018/) for full details on what you need to do and how to enter.

[h1][b]Steam Free Weekend & Sales[/b][/h1]
And finally, if the above wasn’t good enough, Helldivers Free Weekend is underway! Grab your friends and family and enlist them to the Helldivers today!  
The Free Weekend is from Thursday, Oct. 25th at 10am PST to Sunday, Oct. 28th at 10am
 
If you find yourself wanting to continue spreading Managed Democracy long after the Free Weekend, why not pick up Helldivers and some DLC in the sale? It’s 50% off base game and digital deluxe & 60% off DLC packs and bundles. 
The sale starts Thursday, Oct. 25th at 10am PST and Ends Monday, Oct. 29th at 10am.

[b]Good luck Soldiers, and welcome to A New Hell![/b]

notes.title: Liberty Day 2017 – HELLDIVERS everywhere celebrate!
notes.notes:
[b]To all Soldiers of Super Earth, a happy Liberty Day![/b]

In celebration of this occasion, [b]FREE equipment has been added to the Helldivers arsenal[/b] on all platforms (PS4, PS3, PSVita and STEAM). Try new ways to liberate the galaxy with the Heavy Strafing Run, A/GL-8 Launcher Turret or 'Thunderer' Smoke Round.

Furthermore, between October 26th – October 30th [b]HELLDIVERS will be free to download and play[/b] on STEAM. 

We are also hosting a [b]Developer hangout AMA[/b] on Reddit and a [b]Giveaway Competition[/b], read on for the details.

[h1][b][u]New Stratagems added[/u][/b][/h1]

Today 3 new stratagems have been added for all Helldivers to utilize in their endeavor to spread maximum democracy. Unlock them by completing all missions on a planet where they are the indicated reward.

[b]Heavy Strafing Run[/b]
An Eagle fighter jet armed with a 25 mm chain gun strafes the area. The heavy rounds explode on impact, making it far more potent than the regular Strafing Run. This comes with the trade off of a longer time between engagements as the fighter has to swing wide and accelerate to compensate for recoil.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/2093ad3ec36ffa51d64f318db8672b51b924a147.png[/img]

[b]Launcher Turret[/b]
The A/GL-8 Launcher Turret is the latest development in automated sentry technology. Launching the same rounds as the Obliterator, it has immense firepower and shoots over obstacles. Meant for fixed position defense, a variable firing range was not deemed necessary during development. The turret can discern friend from foe, but watch out for the blast radius.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/21bc772df1b6ea2cf3f28267934fda68e29c9877.png[/img]

[b]'Thunderer' Smoke Round[/b]
A single round of smoke is fired from a nearby 'Thunderer' artillery emplacement. The smoke will cover a small area for a short while and block all line of sight.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/3a9d40fe542d38f5e44a1cf1c8674eb3a255509b.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Developer hangout & Competition[/u][/b][/h1]

Throughout Liberty Day we will have developers from Arrowhead available in the pinned Developer hangout thread on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Helldivers/]Reddit /r/Helldivers[/url]. Here you can ask us all your burning questions about Helldivers, Arrowhead and developing games. Main hours will be 10am until 4pm CEST but we will try to follow up and answer additional questions afterward as well.

[b]Fancy a chance to win some HELLDIVERS items[/b] from our goodie box? There will be stickers, pins, coasters and at least one full size cape in the draw! Take part in the Liberty Day giveaway competition by following the simple instructions on the [url=http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2017/10/liberty-day-2017-helldivers-everywhere-celebrate]Arrowhead Blog[/url].

We wish you joyful festivities this happy day!

We are also hosting a [b]Developer hangout AMA[/b] on Reddit and a [b]Giveaway Competition[/b], read on for the details.

[h1][b][u]New Stratagems added[/u][/b][/h1]

Today 3 new stratagems have been added for all Helldivers to utilize in their endeavor to spread maximum democracy. Unlock them by completing all missions on a planet where they are the indicated reward.

[b]Heavy Strafing Run[/b]
An Eagle fighter jet armed with a 25 mm chain gun strafes the area. The heavy rounds explode on impact, making it far more potent than the regular Strafing Run. This comes with the trade off of a longer time between engagements as the fighter has to swing wide and accelerate to compensate for recoil.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/2093ad3ec36ffa51d64f318db8672b51b924a147.png[/img]

[b]Launcher Turret[/b]
The A/GL-8 Launcher Turret is the latest development in automated sentry technology. Launching the same rounds as the Obliterator, it has immense firepower and shoots over obstacles. Meant for fixed position defense, a variable firing range was not deemed necessary during development. The turret can discern friend from foe, but watch out for the blast radius.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/21bc772df1b6ea2cf3f28267934fda68e29c9877.png[/img]

[b]'Thunderer' Smoke Round[/b]
A single round of smoke is fired from a nearby 'Thunderer' artillery emplacement. The smoke will cover a small area for a short while and block all line of sight.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/3a9d40fe542d38f5e44a1cf1c8674eb3a255509b.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Developer hangout & Competition[/u][/b][/h1]

Throughout Liberty Day we will have developers from Arrowhead available in the pinned Developer hangout thread on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Helldivers/]Reddit /r/Helldivers[/url]. Here you can ask us all your burning questions about Helldivers, Arrowhead and developing games. Main hours will be 10am until 4pm CEST but we will try to follow up and answer additional questions afterward as well.

[b]Fancy a chance to win some HELLDIVERS items[/b] from our goodie box? There will be stickers, pins, coasters and at least one full size cape in the draw! Take part in the Liberty Day giveaway competition by following the simple instructions on the [url=http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2017/10/liberty-day-2017-helldivers-everywhere-celebrate]Arrowhead Blog[/url].

We wish you joyful festivities this happy day!

Thank you to everyone who has supported us over the last two years and contributed to this great community. We are proud to spread Democracy with you, Soldiers!

notes.title: Helldivers celebrating Liberty Day 2016!
notes.notes:
Citizens of Super Earth,

Thanks to your bravery in the Galactic Wars we are once again able to wish you a magnificent Liberty Day!
In celebration of this historical anniversary we are giving away free equipment to all Helldivers. There are also some competitions and other events happening on the Arrowhead Website where you can win both in game and real life prizes.
[url=http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2016/10/helldivers-celebrating-liberty-day-2016/] Visit the page here [/url]

[h1][b]New Liberty Day equipment[/b][/h1]

To celebrate Liberty Day all players will receive the new rifle M2016 ‘Constitution’ and the Liberty cape.

The [b]M2016 'CONSTITUTION'[/b] is a reproduction of the old M1903 service rifle used in ancient times. It is fairly ineffective in combat but is used within the Super Earth Armed Forces as a ceremonial rifle. Every citizen is issued one once they turn 16 to encourage service.
While not recommended to bring into the field, it is certainly possible to use for the very skilled or the very brave.

The [b]LIBERTY CAPE[/b] is given to every Helldiver so they will be able to celebrate the big day in style, while also showing their dedication to protecting the precious Liberty we enjoy today.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10733713/e9e936eaf5901a9eb5ca52e92cab6288d1496a4e.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new Liberty Day gear there are two more capes which have been added to the game – the Community Cape and the Developer Cape.

The [b]COMMUNITY CAPE[/b] is given as a reward to outstanding individuals who have participated in – or helped out – the Helldivers community in various ways. Whether that be assistance in solving bugs, guiding new recruits, winning competitions or actively participating and engaging in forum discussions, these individuals can be distinguished from other recruits.

The [b]DEVELOPER CAPE[/b] allows you to recognize members of the developer or publisher teams amidst the chaos of battle. (Shooting or badgering developers will not earn you any rewards, rather the opposite. We just wish to enjoy spreading democracy side by side!)

[h1][b]Livestream and Reddit AMA[/b][/h1]

Tonight between 18:00 and 20:00 CEST we will be playing Helldivers with the community so come and join in! The event will be livestreamed on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/arrowheadgs] Arrowhead's Twitch channel [/url] and all information about how to participate is available there.

Helldivers Game Designer and Producer, Patrik Lasota, will also be taking part in a Reddit AMA over in the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Helldivers/]Helldivers subreddit[/url]. Make sure to stop by and say hi. The AMA thread will be stickied at the top of the page.

notes.title: HELLDIVERS 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Citizens of Super Earth,

[b]Today we celebrate the 1st anniversary of the HELLDIVERS![/b]
[url=arrowheadgamestudios.com/2016/03/helldivers-1-year-anniversary/]Arrowhead Anniversary full blog[/url]

And what a year it has been – We have seen success and we have seen defeat, but the Helldivers always come out on top. We salute your valiant service as we continue to fight for humanity's best interests.

As a token of our gratitude to our Helldivers, we are making new special equipment available to all Super Earth forces for free. The Assault customization set and the LAS-13 'Trident' Laser Shotgun is available in the armory as of today!

[b]This content will be patched in for everyone with a free update, there is no need to download anything from the store.[/b]
[list]
[*]Assault armour cosmetic customization set
[*]LAS-13 'Trident' – This shotgun-like weapon is a further development on the laser carbine technology, allowing for a virtually ammunition independent weapon. Suitable for when you want an easier time hitting your target.
[/list]
We are very proud to have had you with us throughout this year, and in addition to the free in-game content, tonight (March 3rd GMT) we are planning to do various giveaways on our different channels so make sure to keep an eye on them.

[url=facebook.com/Helldivers-815008911923647/]Helldivers Facebook[/url]
[url=twitter.com/helldiversgame]Helldivers Twitter[/url]
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/394510/discussions/]Helldivers Discussion board[/url]

Let's make it another year Soldiers!

notes.title: HELLDIVERS™ deploys on PC today!
notes.notes:
Today Arrowhead and Super Earth Command welcomes all brave PC players to the Helldivers!

[b]HELLDIVERS™ is now available to play on Steam and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/394510] you can find your nearest recruitment center (store page) right here [/url].[/b]

[b][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=78gz-X9TSzo] Watch the trailer here [/url][/b]

[h1]SUPER EARTH NOW CALLS FOR THE IMMEDIATE RECRUITMENT OF MORE HELLDIVERS[/h1]

Citizens, make the most important decision of your life and join the Helldivers! We have a responsibility to liberate all who suffer outside the Freedom and Democracy that Super Earth brings.

[b]AVAILABLE NOW:[/b]
[list]
    [*][b]HELLDIVERS™ for $19.99[/b]
    [*][b]HELLDIVERS™ Digital Deluxe Edition (Game + all DLC) for $39.99[/b]
[/list]
HELLDIVERS™ includes all three free expansions for everyone, up to and including the latest – HELLDIVERS™: Democracy Strikes Back.

Read more about the expansions here:

[url=http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2015/05/helldivers-turns-up-the-heat-today/] Turning up the Heat [/url]

[url=http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2015/07/helldivers-masters-of-the-galaxy-expansion-deploys-today-helldivers-to-launch-on-bluray-2/] Masters of the Galaxy [/url]

[url=http://arrowheadgamestudios.com/2015/10/helldivers-democracy-strikes-back-released-today/] Democracy Strikes Back [/url]

For those who wish to spread even more democracy, individual DLC packs and bundles are also now available. 

Citizens of Super-Earth, the fate of humanity rests in your hands, we welcome you, your friends and family to report to your nearest recruitment center for training.

[b]Important safety tips for all new Helldivers:[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Remember; friendly fire – isn’t.
    [*]Taking out enemies before they eliminate your squad has proven to substantially increase the likelihood of survival.
    [*]HELLDIVERS’ uniforms are not fire proof.
    [*]Being hit by objects, such as Hellpods, launched at supersonic speeds from orbit may cause bodily harm.
    [*]Other instances beside the government may try to spread false propaganda.
    [*]Don’t be afraid of dying, another HELLDIVER will take your place.
    [*]Don’t drink and drive.
[/olist]
So… Are you ready to step up and take your place among the HELLDIVERS?

Get out there soldier, and [b]#SpreadDemocracy[/b] today!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - HELLDIVERS
notes.notes:
HELLDIVERS™ is Now Available on Steam!

HELLDIVERS™ is a hardcore, cooperative, twin stick shooter from the creators of Magicka. As part of the elite unit called the HELLDIVERS, players must work together to protect SUPER EARTH and defeat the enemies of mankind in an intense intergalactic war.

notes.title: HELLDIVERS release date announced, Pre-order NOW!
notes.notes:
Greetings recruits!

Today Arrowhead and Super Earth Command welcomes you to sign up for the fight for Liberty and Democracy by joining the HELLDIVERS.

[b]From today, HELLDIVERS™ is available to pre-order right here in the Steam Store, with the official release set to December 7th.[/b]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9iEf-tbr3Qk] View the trailer here [/url]

These options are available for those who pre-order HELLDIVERS™:

[list]
[*][b]HELLDIVERS™ Vanguard[/b] gives you the Game + Pre-Release Weekend Access on December 4th + Ranger DLC (unlocked on December 7th)
[*][b]HELLDIVERS™ Digital Deluxe[/b] gives you the Game + Pre-Release Weekend Access on December 4th + All DLC (unlocked on December 7th)
[/list]

HELLDIVERS™ PC on Steam will include all three free expansions, up to and including HELLDIVERS™: Democracy Strikes Back.

Our safety depends on everyone doing their duty. Liberating the galaxy is no single individual’s responsibility – but ask yourself: What can YOU do for Super Earth?

WE REMIND YOU – FREEDOM NEVER SLEEPS

Welcome to the HELLDIVERS, new recruits!
